coverage: Morning (Team 1) · Afternoon/Evening — night log not separately captured

sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (07:20 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at Darby St check-in. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at the top of Victoria St West; welfare check 77Convinience Store. All clear, no issues to report. Standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham St; welfare check-in on Ibis Budget Hotel. All clear, no issues to report.
Standing by at the bottom of Wyndham St on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants, as well as for any nearby response calls.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check-in on McDonald's Britomart. All clear, no issues to report.
Standing by at Commercial Bay on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants that may occur within the area.
Leaving standby area; no issues to report.
Arrived at Fort St check-in. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq.
Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq sweep complete. No issues to report. Ending Echo Route.
Arrived at Lorne St; commencing a full sweep down to Auckland Library.
Arrived at Auckland Library; full sweep of Lorne St / welfare checks on stores. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Queens Court; welfare check complete. No issues to report.
Aotea Sq sweep complete. No issues to report. Standing by maintaining security presence, as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving standby area; no issues to report.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive check-in. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria St West / Albert St; welfare checks completed (standing by for nearby response calls and problematic issues or vagrants):
Leaving standby area with no issues to report.
Arrived at lower Albert St; welfare checks completed at the following stores:
Arrived at Commercial Bay; standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area, as well as making our presence known.
Leaving standby area; no issues have occurred. Heading up Queen St, ending Alpha Route.
Arrived at Pocket Park; standing by for security presence as well as nearby response calls.

Response call from Localito regarding a group of vagrants being a disturbance to members of the public as well as the shopkeeper; asked for assistance in moving the vagrants along. Leaving standby area.
Arrived at Localito; the manager informed us that they had already moved along. Standing by in case they return, as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Arrived at Darby St; welfare checks completed at the following stores:
Arrived at Elliot Stables; welfare check. All clear, no issues to report. Standing by.
Aotea Sq sweep complete. No issues to report.

Response call from Lovisa regarding a male that has stolen from their store; the POI has already left the store and was last seen heading up Queen St. Commencing patrols to look for the POI. Description: white bandana, navy blue jacket, red shoes, black pants.
No visuals of the male individual have been spotted; still going to keep an eye out for him whilst patrolling.
Arrived at Durham St West; standing by maintaining security presence.

Response call from 77 Convinience Store regarding 6 males on bikes that stole from 2 different stores at the top of Victoria St West (106, 103 Victoria St West), last seen heading down Albert St. Description: all wearing black clothing with black balaclavas (photo of one of the males provided). Patrolling down to Commercial Bay to look for the male individuals.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; no signs of all 6 males. Standing by.
Heading back to HQ for shift handover.
Morning shift complete; handover to night shift.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Arrived at office debriefing with morning shift.
Heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square.

Received a call from Event Cinemas about a male being aggressive on the premises. We also completed welfare checks from Starbucks till Daikoku Queen St — no issues from the stores. Police are present at Aotea Square for the Palestinian protest. Also a female POI standing in public looks zoned out (photos provided).

Checked the whole Event Cinema building after the manager informed us that the POI walked down the escalators; no sign of him anywhere. We were also informed the male had a female partner who was the female POI zoned out in public. Standing by for security presence (photo provided of the POI).
Heading to the office to charge the Ops phone.

Spoke to a male who may be either under the influence or mentally unstable or potentially both, drinking alcohol in public. We approached him and told him about the liquor-banned area and to finish his drink and throw it in the bin (video provided). Standing by for security presence and maintaining visuals on the POI.
Charging Ops phone which is at 16% (photo provided).
Response call from Jo&Joe requesting assistance for a removal from the property; heading there now.
Whilst making our way to Jo&Joe, received a call back disregarding their request for assistance as the vagrant has vacated the premises. Continuing on for a welfare check-in.

Arrived on-site; conversing with the manager about the event that took place. It was stated that the vagrant was being difficult and verbally aggressive towards the staff and was refused services. No further issues; welfare check complete. Resuming patrol on Queen St heading to Gore St, as Fort St is clear.
Gore St welfare sweep completed at the following:
Welfare sweep on Commercial Bay complete; no issues to report. Welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, clear, no issues. Heading up Queen St for welfare sweep.

Full sweep on lower Queen St complete; no issues to report on local businesses. Standing by upper Queen St, as we and Auckland Council have encountered a runaway child; currently waiting for police to arrive. No further issues. Was informed not to approach the child as they may run away, so we are observing from a distance.
Police have arrived and collected the child; no further issues. Resuming patrol up Queen St heading towards Aotea Sq whilst conducting a welfare check-in.
Welfare check-in on local stores on upper Queen St, Lorne St complete; no issues found to report from the public or any stores. Coming up to Aotea now.
Aotea Square sweep complete; no issues to report. Heading over to Elliot St.
Welfare check-in on Elliot Stables, clear, no issues to report; as well as no issues found on Elliott and Darby St. Making our way up to Victoria St.
Welfare sweep on Victoria St, clear, no issues to report on stores in the area. Heading to the Cathedral Church.
Federal St walkthrough complete; no issues to report.
Welfare check-in on the Cathedral church, clear, no issues to report. Heading to Albert St.
No issues found to report on Albert St; clear, no further issues.
Welfare check-ins complete; no issues to report. Making our way back onto Queen to maintain security presence, as well as standing by for response calls.
Response call from management requesting we stand by Ace Karaoke as the guard has not shown up.
Guards on site; heading back to HQ for 1st break then stand down.
1st guard changeover completed. Standing by for second guard changeover.
